Kenya Communications (Amendment) Act 2008:
• Establishment of a Universal Service Fund
• Electronic Transactions Section provides for electronic means to disseminate statutory
shareholder information.

Migration to the unified licensing regime & licensing of new players
• Safaricom expects to migrate to the new licensing regime by the start of Q2 of 2009.
•The unified license is technologgyy neutral thus allowingg for deliveryy of convergged services

•The new licensing regime may lead to consolidation of existing players to fewer but stronger players
especially at the data carrier, ISP and content provider level
Taxation on Mobile Airtime

• VAT (16%), Excise levy (10%), annual CCK operating fees and the soon to be introduced Universal
Service Fund Levy (0.5% - 1%) continue to make the Kenyan telecommunications market one of the
most heavily taxed markets.
